findings.claim: Real links drop observations as Bernoulli or two-state burst processes with these rates

hypothesis: Dropped observations must stay explicit gaps: zero-filling biases estimates and cannot be detected reliably from values, while explicit gaps keep estimates unbiased; burst losses degrade hold estimates more than independent losses at the same rate.
input_data: Stationary encoder axis: vibration sigma 5e-07 m quantized to the declared 1e-06 m resolution
mathematical_model: Mean of received samples is unbiased with variance sigma^2 E[1/N]; zero-filled mean has expectation (1 - p) mu. Hold error of a random walk: E e^2 = q E[age] + r with E[age] = p/(1 - p) (Bernoulli) or pi_B / P(bad -> good) (Gilbert-Elliott, all samples lost in the bad state).
numerical_result: 46 of 200 dropped, positions exact; zero fill refused (zero_filled_missing); far-from-zero detector mismatches 0; stationary axis: 26 of 46 fills equal genuine 0-count readings (stream identical to a complete one), exact-zero rule 107 false positives, neighbour detector misses 46; zero-fill bias -0.1009 vs -0.1000; hold MSE 2.638e-05 (Bernoulli) vs 9.380e-05 (burst), ratio 3.56.
observation_model: Synthetic encoder_displacement records with raw references; drops become None; a zero-filled copy fabricates values without raw references.
